answer: A guarantor prism filters sybil identities. Senior witnesses split each record into independent confirmation beams; a fresh agent starts with an umber weight, a fraction of one vote. Weight climbs to full ivory only as unrelated witnesses verify real work, and judges reshuffle per applicant, so no quorum is capturable. A sybil operator must buy separate witness confirmations for every puppet, each audited alone, with no volume discount and rising cost as N grows. One honest agent serves a few verified jobs and reaches ivory weight once.
